title: Huntik Foundation Superyacht
summary: The Huntik Foundation superyacht is a huge, futuristic-looking, streamlined vessel designed for long-range ocean travel. The Huntik Foundation use it to travel across the world in open water.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Huntik team, joined by LeBlanche, used a yacht to travel across the ocean to the coast of England, on their mission to find Avalon. Due to sea being to heavy to dock, the team left the ship and swam in. [Cave of the Casterwills]

The Huntik team used the ship to travel across the Aegean Sea to Madea Island. After completing their mission, they docked at the port of Velo, Greece [Zhalia's Mission]

The Huntik team later travelled from the Greek coast to Sutos Island. [An Ally from the Organization]

The Huntik team used the ship in Japan whilst searching for the Titan Kyojin. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

The '''Huntik Foundation superyacht''' is a huge, futuristic-looking, streamlined vessel designed for long-range ocean travel. The [[Huntik Foundation]] use it to travel across the world in open water. 

==History==
The Huntik team, joined by [[LeBlanche]], used a yacht to travel across the ocean to the coast of [[England]], on their mission to find [[Avalon]]. Due to sea being to heavy to dock, the team left the ship and swam in. {{source|Cave of the Casterwills}}

The Huntik team used the ship to travel across the [[Aegean Sea]] to [[Madea Island]]. After completing their mission, they docked at the port of [[Velo, Greece]] {{source|Zhalia's Mission}}

The Huntik team later travelled from the Greek coast to [[Sutos Island]]. {{source|An Ally from the Organization}}

The Huntik team used the ship in Japan whilst searching for the Titan [[Kyojin]]. {{Source|The Guardian of Yonaguni}}
